name: Angelic Brass Breastplate
body:
Aura: moderate abjuration and transmutation; CL 9th ; Slot: chest; Price: 14,000 gp; Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

These polished brass and mithral alloy (“orichalcum”) breastplates were forged by angels and the secret of their making is known by few. They are beautifully etched, intricate, and exceptionally light, yet incredibly strong. Speed while wearing an angelic brass breastplate is 30 feet for Medium creatures, or 20 feet for Small ones. The armor has an arcane spell failure chance of 20%, a maximum Dexterity bonus of +4, and an armor check penalty of –2. It is considered light armor and weighs 15 pounds. Each breastplate has a unique power that it bestows upon a good-aligned wearer, allowing them to use it once per day as a supernatural ability, as a 7th level caster. These powers include one of the following:

bless
feather fall
protection from evil

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells bless, feather fall, protection from evil; Cost: 7,000 gp.
